response.sql: WITH major_counts AS (SELECT link_to_major AS major_id, COUNT(*) AS member_count FROM member WHERE link_to_major IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_major), metrics AS (SELECT major_id, member_count, 1.0 * member_count / SUM(member_count) OVER () AS fraction_of_total, 1.0 * member_count / AVG(member_count) OVER () AS ratio_to_average FROM major_counts) SELECT major_id, member_count, fraction_of_total, ratio_to_average FROM metrics ORDER BY ratio_to_average DESC LIMIT 10;
